messages.author: 94d9353e12412bd5
messages.subject: Plotly doesn't work in shiny
parts:
Hello,

I have a shiny app which I want to use 'plotly' to plot the data which brings more interactive user experience. 

I use an RHEL6.6 server which has both RServer and Shiny (open source version) installed. I install the 'plotly' as a system library.

The app works fine when I just click 'Run App' in the RStudio IDE. However, when I access via shiny server (with http://localhost:3838/roaming_ad/), it prompts "Error: package or namespace load failed for 'plotly'".

If I change to ggplot2, the shiny app works perfect as well. I have tried to remove plotly and install the latest 4.7.1 version but still no luck. 

Can you please kindly advise what I can do to have plotly working within shiny app? Thanks in advance.

Regards,
Jason

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Plotly doesn't work in shiny
parts: I'd try ssh-ing into the server with sudo access, then do "sudo su - shiny" to switch to the "shiny" user, then launch R and see if you can successfully library(plotly). If that doesn't work then you'll know you didn't successfully install plotly as a system library. You can either install it in the shiny user's personal library, or try again with the system library, or try packrat.

messages.subject: Re: Plotly doesn't work in shiny
parts:
Hi Joe,

Thanks a lot for your prompt help on this! 

It turned out that the dependent library 'httr' had been installed as another user's library instead of system library. I reinstalled it as system library and plotly is working perfectly now. Now I learn another trick how to test under "shiny" user.

Thanks again.

Regards,
Jason
